quote: We verify the reading comprehension performance of BLANC with four evaluation metrics (F1, EM, Span-F1, and Span-EM) on three QA datasets
F1 and EM are evaluation metrics widely used in existing QA models ... We propose span-EM and span-F1 as alternatives for evaluating answer-span correctness.
F1 and EM are evaluation metrics widely used in existing QA models . These two metrics measure the number of overlapping tokens between the predicted answers and the ground truth answers.
